## Checklist

- [ ] The PR points to the correct base branch.
- [ ] The PR is linked to the correct issue.
- [ ] The scope matches the issue/subissue.
- [ ] No unrelated functionality was added.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials or local files were committed.
- [ ] No temporary IDE/build files were committed.
- [ ] Architecture boundaries were respected.
- [ ] Validation evidence was included.
- [ ] Visual evidence was included when applicable.
- [ ] The PR closes only the issue it actually implements.
